# 1 Kings Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was, when-Solomon finished building ʾet-the-house-of YHWH and-ʾet-the-house-of the-king and-ʾet-all the-desire-of Solomon that he-desired to-do,

**2** and-YHWH appeared to-Solomon a-second-time, as he-appeared to-him in-Gibeon.

**3** And-YHWH said to-him, "I-have-heard ʾet-your-prayer and-ʾet-your-plea that you-pleaded before-me. I-have-consecrated ʾet-this house that you-built, to-put my-name there forever. And-my-eyes and-my-heart will-be there all the-days.

**4** And-you — if you-walk before-me as David your-father walked, in-integrity-of heart and-in-uprightness, to-do according-to-all that I-commanded-you, and-my-statutes and-my-judgments you-keep —

**5** then-I-will-establish ʾet-the-throne-of your-kingdom over Israel forever, as I-spoke to David your-father, saying, 'There-shall-not be-cut-off for-you a-man from-upon the-throne-of Israel.'

**6** If you-will-surely-turn — you and-your-sons — from-following-me, and-you-do-not keep my-commandments and-my-statutes that I-set before-you, and-you-go and-serve other gods and-bow-down to-them —

**7** then-I-will-cut-off ʾet-Israel from-upon the-face-of the-land that I-gave to-them, and-the-house that I-consecrated for-my-name I-will-send-away from-my-face. And-Israel will-be a-proverb and-a-byword among all the-peoples.

**8** And-this house will-be a-heap-of-ruins. Everyone passing by-it will-be-appalled and-will-hiss, and-they-will-say, 'Why has YHWH done thus to-this land and-to-this house?'

**9** And-they-will-say, 'Because they-forsook ʾet-YHWH their-God, who brought-out ʾet-their-fathers from-the-land-of Egypt, and-they-seized other gods and-bowed-down to-them and-served-them — therefore YHWH brought upon-them ʾet-all this evil.'"

**10** And-it-was at-the-end-of twenty years, in-which Solomon built ʾet-the-two houses — ʾet-the-house-of YHWH and-ʾet-the-house-of the-king —

**11** Hiram king-of Tyre had-supplied ʾet-Solomon with-cedar timber and-cypress timber and-gold, according-to-all his-desire — then the-king Solomon gave to-Hiram twenty cities in-the-land-of Galilee.

**12** And-Hiram went-out from-Tyre to-see ʾet-the-cities that Solomon had-given to-him, and-they-were-not right in-his-eyes.

**13** And-he-said, "What are-these cities that you-gave to-me, my-brother?" And-he-called-them the-land-of Cabul, to this day.

**14** And-Hiram had-sent to-the-king a-hundred and-twenty talents-of gold.

**15** And-this is the-account-of the-labor-levy that the-king Solomon raised to-build ʾet-the-house-of YHWH and-ʾet-his-own-house and-ʾet-the-Millo and-ʾet-the-wall-of Jerusalem and-ʾet-Hazor and-ʾet-Megiddo and-ʾet-Gezer.

**16** Pharaoh king-of Egypt had-gone-up and-captured ʾet-Gezer and-burned-it with-fire, and-ʾet-the-Canaanites dwelling in-the-city he-killed. And-he-gave-it as-a-dowry to-his-daughter, the-wife-of Solomon.

**17** And-Solomon built ʾet-Gezer and-ʾet-lower Beth-horon

**18** and-ʾet-Baalath and-ʾet-Tamar in-the-wilderness, in-the-land,

**19** and-ʾet-all the-storage-cities that Solomon had, and-ʾet-the-chariot-cities and-ʾet-the-cities-of the-horsemen, and-ʾet-the-desire-of Solomon that he-desired to-build in-Jerusalem and-in-the-Lebanon and-in-all the-land-of his-dominion.

**20** All the-people who-were-left from-the-Amorites, the-Hittites, the-Perizzites, the-Hivites, and-the-Jebusites — who were not from-the-sons-of Israel —

**21** their-sons who-were-left after-them in-the-land, whom the-sons-of Israel were-not able to-devote-to-destruction — Solomon raised from-them a-levy-of forced-labor, to this day.

**22** But-from the-sons-of Israel Solomon did-not make a-slave, for they were the-men-of war and-his-servants and-his-officers and-his-captains and-the-commanders-of his-chariots and-his-horsemen.

**23** These were the-chiefs-of the-officers who were over the-work-of Solomon — five-hundred and-fifty, who-ruled over the-people who-did the-work.

**24** Only the-daughter-of Pharaoh went-up from-the-City-of David to her-house that he-built for-her. Then he-built ʾet-the-Millo.

**25** And-Solomon offered three times in-the-year burnt-offerings and-peace-offerings upon the-altar that he-built for-YHWH, and-he-burned-incense with-it — that which was before YHWH. And-he-finished the-house.

**26** And-a-fleet-of-ships the-king Solomon made in-Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on-the-shore-of the-Sea-of Reeds, in-the-land-of Edom.

**27** And-Hiram sent in-the-fleet ʾet-his-servants, men-of ships, who-knew the-sea, with the-servants-of Solomon.

**28** And-they-came to-Ophir, and-they-took from-there gold — four-hundred and-twenty talents — and-brought-it to the-king Solomon.

---
## EMET Textual Notes

1. **9:3 — "my-eyes and-my-heart will-be there"**: God's response to Solomon's prayer is deeply personal — eyes and heart permanently oriented toward the temple. This is covenant intimacy expressed architecturally.

2. **9:7-8 — "a-heap-of-ruins"**: The Hebrew ʿelyon may also mean "exalted/highest," creating a bitter wordplay — the exalted house becomes the ruined heap. God prophesies the temple's destruction at the moment of its consecration.

3. **9:13 — "Cabul"**: The name may derive from a root meaning "as nothing" or "worthless." Hiram's disappointment with the cities is diplomatically devastating.

4. **9:15 — the-Millo**: A terraced structure filling in the gap between the City of David and the Temple Mount. The Hebrew mil'o means "filling" — an engineering project that literally filled a geographical void.

5. **9:26-28 — Ophir**: The legendary source of gold. Its exact location remains debated (southern Arabia, East Africa, India). The fleet represents Solomon's global trade ambitions.

— EMET
